t1.text: Site nav — Option C: sidebar everywhere on desktop, collapsible to a lettered rail

h1.text:
Handoff · desktop only, mobile unchanged

Expanded: 250px column = 32px inset + 170px nav + 48px gap. Collapsed: 92px = 8px inset + 44px rail + 40px gap.

Rail: 34px mugshot (home), then A / P / G section links, current section in accent with a 2px leading rule, then Expand and theme buttons.

The artboards omit the site name and "All apps..."; keep both. README.md in this folder wins over the artboards.
